claims.text: A statement from Congressman Tom Cole's office dated 10 April 2024 records that 'the full House Republican Conference ratified him as Chairman of the House Appropriations Committee.'
Because Cole's chairmanship began on 10 April 2024, Kay Granger and not Cole held the House Appropriations 119(e)(2) seat on 26 July 2023, the date of the Grusch testimony.

edges.label: Representative, Oklahoma 4th district; Chairman of Appropriations from April 2024
edges.note: The House Appropriations chairmanship is one of only two House seats in the section 119 group that sit on the money side; the other is the Defense Subcommittee chair held by Ken Calvert.

edges.label: Chairman, House Appropriations Committee
edges.note: Start date corrected from the board's earlier undated entry. Ratified by the House Republican Conference on 10 April 2024, succeeding Kay Granger mid-term in the 118th Congress. Still in the chair as of a committee release dated 24 June 2026. He therefore did not hold a 119(e)(2) seat on the date of the Grusch testimony.

topics.title: Who gets told: 10 U.S.C. 119, the Gang of Eight and the waived-SAP notification group
